mapper.select: select p.id, p.album_id, p.seq, p.rel_path, p.bytes, p.w, p.h, p.is_big from media_photo p inner join media_album a on a.id = p.album_id and a.hidden = 0 where p.hidden = 0 order by p.album_id asc, p.seq asc

select p.id, p.album_id, p.seq, p.rel_path, p.bytes, p.w, p.h, p.is_big from media_photo p inner join media_album a on a.id = p.album_id and a.hidden = 0 where p.hidden = 0 and p.album_id = #{albumId} order by p.seq asc
select count(*) from media_photo p inner join media_album a on a.id = p.album_id and a.hidden = 0 where p.album_id = #{albumId} and p.seq = #{seq} and p.hidden = 0
